Summary of the skin clinic visit for Gergely Halász on 3 November.

Dr Fekete prescribed tretinoin 0.025% cream: every second evening for the first two weeks, then nightly if there is no peeling. It should not go on freshly shaved skin, and a mineral SPF 50 is needed every morning, even when it is cloudy.

Gergely also said he stopped taking his antidepressant, sertraline, three weeks ago without telling his GP, because he suspected it was making the acne worse. Dr Fekete said this must be raised with the GP before any other treatment changes, and that the skin cream is not the cause.

The next appointment is on 12 December at 09:40. Cancellations need 24 hours' notice on +36 96 555 0142, and the clinic will not hold a slot without a call.
